SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Gramm ar in Use 11.3.1 Interrogatives, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: when clauses with present tense to show the future: ‘When are you going to school?
